quarterly_data.quarter: Mastercard press release: Mastercard Advances Agentic Commerce With New Trust and (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard expanded Agent Pay with trust and intelligence services forming the intelligence layer of its Agent Pay Trust Framework; the first, rolling out for testing in the U.S., is a probability score of how likely a transaction was initiated by an AI agent. Mastercard is working with Cloudflare to create privacy-preserving environments that combine web and payment-network signals on AI-driven payment activity (exploratory), and with Skyfire, whose Know Your Agent (KYA) agent identity and verification technology is being extended into Agent Pay. Mastercard projects one in 10 consumers will routinely use agents to make purchases by 2030.
